approved_text:
Implemented your rule in [project guidance](https://joern-pc.tailc5e761.ts.net/files/workspaces/msc-math/AGENTS.md): prepared messages require a separate subagent to approve their complete text, including the reviewer attribution. Direct synchronous discussion stays exempt.

The reviewer checks relevance, burden on you, evidence, continuation and presentation. The portable checker rejects altered text, changed context, missing checks and self-review. Revisions require renewed approval. Eight focused tests pass.

**The remaining limitation is enforcement:** this runtime has no pre-delivery message hook. The protocol is independently checkable, but a sender can still bypass it. A hard block would require a buffering client or runtime change.

This message went through the new gate.

evidence_scope.reason: Active guidance and inspected checker support the stated requirements and rejection cases. Eight focused tests passed in reviewer verification. Release-specific runtime evidence supports the hook limitation; bypass and hard-block limits are explicit.

continuation.reason: The selected actionable-rule package is complete with the mandatory context fix, workflow and checker; parent retains native identity verification, checker and focused commit before unchanged delivery. No feasible implementation task is pushed back to Jörn.

communication.reason: Concise outcome-first explanation separates the implemented protocol, test evidence and material runtime limit; exact reviewer attribution is included.
